reviewedState: Uncommitted prepared consumer storage, job ownership, recovery and publication implementation as available during review; final evaluation and CI were not reviewed.
observations: The prepared reader verifies bounded retained metadata and prepared bytes, source provenance and expiration without reading original HTML or optional extraction inputs.

Expired job claims remain discoverable after retry exhaustion and receive terminal-only ownership for publication of an incomplete result. Checkpoints prevent another model call after ownership loss or uncertain usage.

Publication is guarded by the current prepared job owner and unexpired lease; cleanup uses bounded expiry-indexed batches. The new offline roundtrip exercises real SQLite and object-store paths with mocked inference.
limitations: This is a scoped review of storage, ownership, recovery and publication, not a complete assessment of the change.
Source-bound evaluation, hosted CI, native CPU measurement, live provider behavior and deployment were not verified. No live calls were made.
